# Ali Akhmad Fauzie — Principal Solutions Architect Editorial Design System

## Aesthetic Philosophy & Anti-Slop Invariants
- **High-Craft Swiss Editorial & Industrial Precision**: Inspired by Linear, Vercel Geist, Stripe Press, and Bloomberg Terminal typography.
- **Matte Carbon & Emerald Architecture**: Deep matte obsidian-slate canvas (`#0B0D0E`), elevated structural panels (`#121518`), crisp `1px` hairline dividers (`#22272E`), and high-contrast emerald architectural accents (`#10B981` / `#006C4C`).
- **Strict 4px Industrial Geometry**: Use tight `4px` (`rounded-sm`) corners on buttons, badges, code blocks, and cards. Never use pill buttons or floating neon gradients.
- **Typography Hierarchy**:
  - **Headlines**: Space Grotesk — tight tracking (`-0.03em`), authoritative geometric display titles.
  - **Body**: Plus Jakarta Sans — high legibility for deep technical case studies (`#F3F4F6` primary text, `#9CA3AF` secondary text).
  - **Monospace Telemetry & Code**: JetBrains Mono — tabular numerals (`tabular-nums`) for KPI counters, latency benchmarks, file paths, and code citations.
